intro.text: A singer leader in direform who, long ago, argued against the Windrunner Garith in peace talks between singers and Radiants.
A singer leader in direform who, long ago, secretly met with the Windrunner Garith out of a shared wish for peace.

items.text: Years before, Shmone stabbed Garith when they first met on the battlefield, but he was understanding. Though enemies, they began meeting in secret, sharing a wish for peace.

As a leader of her people under Ba-Ado-Mishram, Shmone argued fiercely against Garith in peace talks, demanding more farmland. When he refused to fight human kings for it, she and her contingent left in anger.

Shmone persuaded Ba-Ado-Mishram to meet the Windrunners in good faith, but Melishi's strike team sprang from hiding and captured the Unmade in a gemstone. Shmone's form was ripped from her, and Garith held her as she lost part of herself.

appearance.text: In direform she is covered in carapace barbs, with skin in large patches of black and red, an intense stare, and is taller than Garith.
